nom: Curology Face Moisturizer for Dry Skin

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin mostly find it deeply hydrating, including for a dry T-zone, though one reviewer with super dry skin found it not quite moisturizing enough and missed a dewier finish.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including some who say they break out easily, consistently report no irritation or new breakouts from this moisturizer.
segments.combination: The one reviewer with combination skin reports it moisturizes without the greasy feeling she usually avoids from other face products.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the moisturizer as deeply hydrating and well-absorbed, including for a naturally dry T-zone; one reviewer with super dry skin, however, found it not moisturizing enough for her needs and missed a dewy finish.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers, including several with sensitive or breakout-prone skin, consistently report no irritation from this moisturizer.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers report no new breakouts from the moisturizer itself, and one reviewer credits the broader Curology line, including this moisturizer, with keeping her acne under control.

aspects.libelle: Pump stops working with product still trapped inside
Printed lettering rubs off onto hands and face
Small bottle feels pricey at full price
Airless pump design feels premium and sanitary

extraits.texte: Curology is a great line. They really have helped with keeping my acne at bay. This is a good gentle moisturizer for sensitive skin. I have super dry skin so its not quite as moisturizing as I'd like and doesn't leave my skin looking dewy which is a disappointment for me personally but otherwise its pretty good.

extraits.titre: Moisturizer is great but fix the pump!
extraits.texte: I love this product because it's non-comodogenic and gives my face the right amount of hydration. However, I just accidentally found out that once the pump stops working it does NOT mean that it's empty!! I've bought so many of these and once it gets to a point where I pump it like 10-20 times and nothing comes out, I assume that it's empty and throw it away. Yesterday I was doing the same and it accidentally fell and the top broke open and guess what?? More than half the bottle was still full!!! They really need to fix the pump because it only pumps out half the product. It would be a real shame if they already know this and use it as a tactice to get people to buy more. Please fix the pump so we can get all of the product inside!

The best moisturizer. I only buy this product now for daily moisturizer. This is a thicker moisturizer, but promotes hydration in the skin and absorbs well. I use it in the AM and PM after washing my face and one container lasts about 2 months. I have really sensitive skin and easily breakout, however this moisturizer works well for me and does not cause irritation or break out.

Good formula, doesn't cause me any problems. However, as others have said, the pump sucks. The product gets stuck in the pump, and sometimes it just doesn't even work...and if that happens, there's no way to fix it. I wish the packaging was better cause the formula is the best I have used (no pilling, great absorbency, doesn't cause any irritation or breakouts even on sensitive skin). If you don't mind the packaging being a bit frustrating, definitely give it a try.

This is a very nice, hydrating facial moisturizer, and is great for anyone with dry skin or just those who need a little extra hydration in these colder months. With this, it is sulfate free, cruelty free, vegan and dermatology tested. I love the ingredients line up as well, which includes aloe vera, hyaluronic acid, squalene, shea butter and more. For the current sale price of $16.99 I would definitely order this again. However, I do believe that the “original” price of $42.99 is quite extreme for this small 1.7 fluid ounce bottle.

I have combination skin and don’t always like applying products on my face as they can make it feel greasy But with these Midwest winters sometimes you just need something to help moisturize your face Curology is a great brand that is backed by dermatologist This cream has a fun pump on it that gives you the right amount The cream is moisturizing but not greasy which I love. It’s also fragrance free which is perfect for sensitive skin
Nice lightweight moisturizer. It is not greasy and rubs in nicely. My t-zone is the opposite of most people’s and is dry. This helps moisturize the area all day. No scent.
